Fast Foods and Convenience Foods
Convenience foods include foods and beverages from vending 
machines, canteens, school stores, fast-food restaurants, and 
convenience stores. As adolescents spend considerable amounts 
of time in and around schools, convenience foods available at 
school and in the surrounding neighborhood are likely to influ-
ence their eating patterns. National data indicate vending 
machines are available in 72% of middle schools and 87% of 
high schools (Fox et al, 2012). One in five middle schools and
